description: Issuance-policy / OID-group-link abuse (ESC13): a certificate confers membership in a linked group.

telemetry.detail: Certificate request logged on the CA.
PKINIT TGT request with the issued certificate.
A certificate whose issuance policy links to a privileged group grants that group's access on authentication.

prerequisite_privilege: Enroll on a template with an issuance policy linked to a privileged group (msDS-OIDToGroupLink)
abuse_primitive: Enroll the template; the resulting cert grants the linked group's access.
notes: Access comes from the OID-to-group link, not the SAN - a subtler ADCS path.
